parse.text:
Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 5.5 - Fairy Tail Update Part 2

Overview

Jelly is a Secret Limited unit. He was only obtainable as a random drop in the Heavenly Invasion event.

Evolving

Jelly can evolve into Jelly (Heaven) with the following materials:

Required Items: x1 Jelly
x1 Celestial Tear
x10 Infused Crystal
x40 Magical Artifact

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
